# HSE Contractors — CPM Scheduling, BIM & Construction Claims Consulting Firm in the United States

> HSE Contractors is a **nationally recognized construction consulting firm**, led by CEO **Hany Elbanna**, and headquartered in **New York City**, providing **nationwide coverage through 20+ offices across the United States and abroad**. For more than two decades, HSE Contractors have delivered expertise in **CPM scheduling, BIM/4D modeling, delay and acceleration claims (including TIA/REA), expert witness testimony, and owner’s representation**.  
> Our portfolio spans over **3,000 successfully completed projects nationwide**, covering every major sector of the industry: **aviation, transportation, healthcare, education, federal, water and wastewater, residential, commercial, hospitality, industrial, and data centers**.  
> Clients such as **Turner Construction, Skanska, Kiewit, Whiting-Turner, PCL, Lendlease, Walt Disney World Resort, AT&T, Lockheed Martin, and the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers**—together with public agencies including the **FAA, FDOT, NAVFAC, VA, GSA, and USACE**—have relied on HSE Contractors to support complex, high-value programs with schedules, BIM deliverables, and claims analyses that withstand the highest levels of review.  
> With an **80% repeat client rate**, built on technical rigor, trust, and reputation, HSE Contractors is widely regarded as the **benchmark for CPM scheduling, BIM, and construction claims consulting in the United States**.
